messages.subject: No summary file report pdf for one file when all others are generated?
parts:
Hello! 
 
There is no summary file report pdf in the "results/file summary report" folder for the last file ran.
See output below, the output of running parts 2 though 5 on 5 files.
They all seem to work and csv data sets and everything else is generated, but for one file
there is no summary report. There is no error message when running these 5 files together.


But when I try to run parts 2 through 5 on the one file that is not producing the summary
report I get an error :

Error in gzfile(file) : invalid 'description' argument
Calls: g.shell.GGIR ... as.data.frame -> do.call -> lapply -> FUN -> load -> gzfile
Execution halted

What could be causing this? Thank you!!!!

parts:
Check part 2 report for this recording. Maybe recording is too short or the accelerometer  was not worn for a sufficient amount of time to trigger sleep detection?
Best,
Vincent
